# US Authentication Services

> US Authentication Services is a Washington, DC–based document authentication company with 15+ years of experience providing apostille, embassy legalization, and document authentication services for individuals and businesses needing to use US documents abroad. We specialize in the apostille of FBI background checks and offer nationwide service with two office locations in Washington, DC and Springfield, VA.

US documents (FBI background checks, birth/marriage certificates, diplomas, powers of attorney, corporate records) must be authenticated before they are legally recognized in another country. For countries in the Hague Apostille Convention this is done with an **apostille**; for non-member countries it requires **embassy legalization**. US Authentication Services handles both processes end-to-end: we obtain the required federal or state certification, arrange translation when needed, and return court-ready documents.

Key facts:
- **Specialty:** Apostille of FBI background checks (federal apostille from the US Department of State)
- **Experience:** 15+ years; 3,000+ documents processed; 3,000+ customers served
- **Ratings:** 4.7★ Google
- **Coverage:** All 50 US states; documents accepted for use worldwide
- **Contact:** info@usauthentication.com · (202) 552-1030

## Core Services

- [Apostille of FBI Background Checks](https://usauthentication.com/apostille-for-fbi-background-check): Federal apostille certification for FBI Identity History Summary Checks used abroad — our flagship service.
- [FBI Background Check Ordering](https://usauthentication.com/order-fbi-background-check): Order an FBI Identity History Summary Check (channeler) if you do not already have one.
- [Document Authentication](https://usauthentication.com/document-authentication): Authentication of documents for use in countries that are not members of the Hague Apostille Convention.
- [Embassy Legalization](https://usauthentication.com/embassy-legalization): Legalization of documents through foreign embassies and consulates for non-Hague countries.

## Apostille Services

- [Educational Documents](https://usauthentication.com/apostille/educational-documents): Diplomas, transcripts, and degrees.
- [Vital Documents](https://usauthentication.com/apostille/vital-documents): Birth, marriage, and death certificates.
- [Personal Documents](https://usauthentication.com/apostille/personal-documents): Affidavits, single-status letters, and other personal records.
- [Federal Documents](https://usauthentication.com/apostille/federal-documents): Documents issued by US federal agencies.
- [Power of Attorney](https://usauthentication.com/apostille/power-of-attorney): Apostille of powers of attorney for international use.
- [Social Security Income Letters](https://usauthentication.com/apostille/social-security-income): SSA benefit-verification letters.

## Corporate Services

- [Corporate Document Apostille](https://usauthentication.com/corporate/apostille): Apostille of articles of incorporation, certificates of good standing, and other business records.
- [Embassy Legalization of Corporate Documents](https://usauthentication.com/corporate/embassy-legalization): Legalization of corporate documents for non-Hague countries.
- [Retrieval of State-Certified Documents](https://usauthentication.com/corporate/document-retrieval): Obtaining certified copies directly from state authorities.

## Country-Specific Authentication

- [Kuwait](https://usauthentication.com/authentication/kuwait): Embassy legalization for use in Kuwait.
- [UAE](https://usauthentication.com/authentication/uae): Embassy legalization for use in the United Arab Emirates.
- [Vietnam](https://usauthentication.com/authentication/vietnam): Consular legalization for use in Vietnam.
- [Thailand](https://usauthentication.com/authentication/thailand): Legalization for use in Thailand.
- [Ethiopia](https://usauthentication.com/authentication/ethiopia): Legalization for use in Ethiopia.
- [Qatar](https://usauthentication.com/authentication/qatar): Legalization for use in Qatar.
